messages.snippet: Dear all, Our document management system and network drives will be unavailable on Saturday 7 March
messages.subject: Planned maintenance: DMS and document services Saturday 7 March
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

Our document management system and network drives will be unavailable on Saturday 7 March from 07:00 to approximately 13:00 BST for scheduled maintenance and a security patch. Please save and close all documents before close of business on Friday. Email will be unaffected.

If you have an urgent weekend filing deadline, contact the IT duty officer in advance.

Thanks
IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
